title: Supported image audio generation providers

context.summary: Promote image and audio generation operations from SDK diagnostics to supported provider paths.
context.background: The v0.1.1 support target includes generation roles with byte output validation, audit records and runnable provider contracts.

in: Implement supported image generation through local-http, local-command or a documented provider profile.
Implement supported audio generation through local-http, local-command or a documented provider profile.
Validate MIME type, byte output, model-operation audit records and CLI smoke commands.
Document provider configuration and failure diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria: Image generation returns valid bytes, MIME metadata and audit records.
Audio generation returns valid bytes, MIME metadata and audit records.
CLI smoke commands exercise both operations through @mindory/llm.
Errors are typed and user-facing diagnostics are clear.

manual_checks: Run provider smoke commands with configured local profiles.
Confirm generated bytes can be opened by standard tools.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
